data.title: St. Louis men indicted in attempted robbery of teen involved in $245 million Bitcoin theft
data.description: Federal prosecutors say three St. Louis men traveled to Connecticut to help kidnap a teen linked to a $245 million Bitcoin theft. They have pleaded not guilty.
data.author: Dana Rieck | Post-Dispatch
data.keywords: bitcoin, kidnapping, st. louis, robbery, criminal conspiracy, law-related events, crimes, crime, prosecutor, theft
